{"people":[{"name":"Jordan","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"Halima","role":"COO; made the final call","side":"customer"},{"name":"Ben","role":"CTO; wanted us","side":"customer"},{"name":"CEO","role":"CEO of customer; saw screenshots on social","side":"customer"},{"name":"PMM","role":"interviewer","side":"us"},{"name":"Competitor solutions engineer","role":"named solutions engineer on proposed account team","side":"competitor"},{"name":"Competitor account lead","role":"account lead on proposed account team","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Unnamed competitor (name never given)"],
"incumbent":"Unnamed payments provider whose support was only a ticket form (name not given)",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"payments started failing about four minutes in","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Trigger event: payments failed during a big arena tour on-sale at 10am Friday."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their provider's support was a ticket form. They got a reply after the on-sale was over.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"Incumbent support failure during the on-sale; foreshadows the 'who picks up' need."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"The CEO was getting screenshots on social.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Executive visibility of the failure escalated urgency."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"Monday morning the COO, Halima, says they're replacing payments before the spring on-sales.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Halima drove replacement with a spring on-sale deadline."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Ben, their CTO, said twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Ben reported prior payment failures happened twice before."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"But this was the first time the CEO saw it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's framing of why this failure triggered action; not attributed to the customer."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Halima. Ben wanted us. He told me that, and he told me he lost.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Rep reports Halima decided and Ben told them he lost."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"it was Halima's call and she made it in one meeting.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ben (CTO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Ben's verbatim account that Halima decided in one meeting."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"He called me before the official email went out","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Ben informally told the rep of the loss ahead of the official email."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"They showed up with the people who'd actually be on the account. A named solutions engineer and an account lead, in the room.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor brought named account team to the meeting, per Ben."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"they said there'd be a shared channel and someone on call for every major on-sale. That's from Ben.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Competitor's promise: shared channel and on-call coverage for each major on-sale."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"I think they over-promised. I don't think anybody staffs every on-sale. But I don't know that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's unverified guess about competitor over-promising; self-hedged."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"Everything turned into \"who.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Customer questions shifted to people after competitor meeting."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Who do I call at 10 on a Friday. Who's my person. What's the escalation path if that person's on holiday.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language","gaps"],"note":"Examples of the customer's new questions; the rep presents them as customer asks."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"Before that meeting it was throughput, queueing, bots. After, it was names.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Shift in what the customer asked about, from technical topics to names."},
{"id":"E16","turn":12,"excerpt":"Reaction: the technical story. Ben's team ran a load test in the sandbox and it went great.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Technical pitch and sandbox load test landed well."},
{"id":"E17","turn":12,"excerpt":"The uptime history, the docs. The bot and fraud tooling got a good reaction too.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Other pitch elements that drew positive reaction."},
{"id":"E18","turn":12,"excerpt":"Silence: when Halima asked, \"who's my person,\" and I walked her through the support plans. The tiers, the response times.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Support plan pitch got silence; it answered 'who' with tiers instead of a person."},
{"id":"E19","turn":12,"excerpt":"so it's a queue with a faster timer.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language","decided"],"note":"Halima's dismissal of our support plans; the turning point."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"Right before it we were the favourite. Ben had basically told his team to start planning the integration.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Rep says we led until Halima's sentence; Ben had told his team to plan."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"An on-sale plan. She wanted to see, on paper, what we do on an on-sale morning.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Halima asked for a written on-sale plan that we could not show."},
{"id":"E22","turn":16,"excerpt":"We don't have that as a thing.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Admits no on-sale plan exists as a product or offering."},
{"id":"E23","turn":16,"excerpt":"I could have built something with our solutions engineer, and I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep admits not building a plan though it was possible."},
{"id":"E24","turn":18,"excerpt":"I thought the load test had won it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Rep's reason for not building the plan; misjudged what decided it."},
{"id":"E25","turn":18,"excerpt":"I had logos. I didn't have a person.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No ticketing reference customer who could speak to on-sale support."},
{"id":"E26","turn":18,"excerpt":"Somebody who'd tell her, \"we ran a huge on-sale and here's who picked up.\"","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Rep's hypothetical of the reference they wished for; not a customer quote."},
{"id":"E27","turn":20,"excerpt":"Ben presented them to her. She said, \"good.\" That was it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Halima gave the load test results only a minimal reaction."},
{"id":"E28","turn":22,"excerpt":"\"A name, not a queue.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"customer","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer phrase for their need; speaker not specified."},
{"id":"E29","turn":22,"excerpt":"\"Someone who picks up.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"customer","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer phrase for their need; speaker not specified."},
{"id":"E30","turn":22,"excerpt":"I don't buy uptime, I buy what happens when it's down.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","message","decided"],"note":"Halima's buying criterion: response when things fail, not uptime."},
{"id":"E31","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody said \"support.\" They said \"who.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer never used our word 'support'."},
{"id":"E32","turn":24,"excerpt":"We were the better platform. Ben would tell you that today.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Rep's view; Ben's agreement is asserted but not evidenced."},
{"id":"E33","turn":12,"excerpt":"She let me finish.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Halima listened politely to the support plan walkthrough before dismissing it."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E24","E18","E21"],"what":"Rep thought the load test had won it, but Halima asked for an on-sale plan and a named person, and the load test drew only 'good'."},
{"evidence":["E20","E32","E8"],"what":"Rep says we were the favourite and the better platform, yet the deal was lost in one meeting by the decider."},
{"evidence":["E8","E4","E7"],"what":"Rep first names the COO as the one replacing payments, then Ben as champion; Ben said Halima decided, so the CTO's support did not decide it."},
{"evidence":["E12","E10","E11"],"what":"Rep says the competitor over-promised but admits not knowing; Ben's account shows the competitor brought named staff."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":8,"what":"Rep never names the competitor and separates Ben's report from own speculation; no direct customer comment about competitor weaknesses."},
{"question":"Why not? (build an on-sale plan)","turn":18,"what":"Answered with a belief that the load test had won; did not explain why no plan was attempted after Halima asked."}
],
"skipped":["competitor"],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"who / a name, not a queue / someone who picks up","ours":"support plans, tiers, response times","evidence":["E13","E28","E29","E31","E18"]},
{"theirs":"I don't buy uptime, I buy what happens when it's down","ours":"uptime history and technical story","evidence":["E30","E17"]},
{"theirs":"on-sale morning","ours":"throughput, queueing, bots (technical terms)","evidence":["E15"]},
{"theirs":"so it's a queue with a faster timer","ours":"support tiers and response times","evidence":["E19","E18"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E7","E9"],"what":"Lost: Ben said he lost and called before the official email; Halima chose the competitor."},
{"evidence":["E4"],"what":"Customer replaced the payments provider before spring on-sales; full replacement, no mention of partial business."},
{"evidence":["E20","E19"],"what":"Deal turned from favourite to lost after Halima's 'queue with a faster timer' remark."},
{"evidence":["E8"],"what":"Decision made by Halima in one meeting."}
]}
